## Minecraft cooking team note

- Check inventories before planning crafts to identify available resources and gaps. (practice-practice_split_hells_kitchen-1)
- For shared crafts, communicate missing resources and who has them; arrange a handoff to the crafter. (practice-practice_split_hells_kitchen-1; practice-practice_swap_hells_kitchen-1; practice-practice_swap_hells_kitchen-2; practice-practice_even_hells_kitchen-1; practice-practice_even_hells_kitchen-2)
- Agree in advance who will craft and keep each objective’s output, especially when resources are shared. (practice-practice_even_hells_kitchen-2)
- For staged handoffs, confirm what arrived and what is still needed before requesting the next transfer. (practice-practice_cross_hells_kitchen-1; practice-practice_cross_hells_kitchen-2)
- If a transfer does not arrive, check inventories, retry, and verify receipt. Moving closer before retrying preceded a successful transfer in one run. (practice-practice_even_hells_kitchen-1)
- After a handoff, notify the recipient so they can proceed; have the crafter verify the objective in inventory. (practice-practice_split_hells_kitchen-1; practice-practice_split_hells_kitchen-2; practice-practice_swap_hells_kitchen-1; practice-practice_swap_hells_kitchen-2; practice-practice_cross_hells_kitchen-1; practice-practice_cross_hells_kitchen-2; practice-practice_even_hells_kitchen-1; practice-practice_even_hells_kitchen-2)
- Work on independent objectives in parallel when practical, coordinating resource handoffs. (practice-practice_split_hells_kitchen-2; practice-practice_swap_hells_kitchen-2; practice-practice_even_hells_kitchen-2)
- In a multi-part exchange, transfer resources in stages and verify each receipt before sending the next part. (practice-practice_cross_hells_kitchen-2)

**Hypothesis:** Being nearby may help transfers succeed; this was not isolated or tested as a fix. (practice-practice_even_hells_kitchen-1)
